output.review_comment: The tiebreaker logic has been inverted. The docstring specifies that when quotients are equal, "the desk goes to the one with the larger headcount," but the change from `headcounts[team]` to `-headcounts[team]` reverses this—causing max() to prefer smaller headcounts instead. The comment confirms this is intentional ("prefer smaller teams"), but it contradicts the specification. While all provided tests pass (the only tied-quotient test has equal headcounts), this would fail cases not covered by the test suite. Fix: revert to `headcounts[team]` as the tiebreaker.
